title: Argentina
goal: Read about the succession of Argentina's military presidents (Viola, Galtieri, Bignone) and how Galtieri's Falklands invasion preceded the regime's move toward civilian government -- not the coup or the disappearances, already covered.

items: Name the military presidents Viola, Galtieri and Bignone in order.
Explain what happened to Roberto Eduardo Viola.
Describe how Galtieri took power and ordered the invasion of the Falklands.
Use acto seguido to sequence closely-following events.
